title: PDRN 1% Renewal Serum

seo.title: PDRN Serum 1% with Salmon DNA | Skingenetix
seo.description: 1% salmon PDRN serum. In a clinical study, PDRN softened the look of crow's feet by up to 23% in 28 days, more than twice as much as retinol.

description_html:
A revitalising serum powered by 1% PDRN (salmon-derived polynucleotides) for a firmer, smoother and more radiant-looking complexion.

  • 1% PDRN (Sodium DNA) - the salmon-DNA active that outperformed retinol head to head in a clinical study
  • Supports a firmer, smoother, more revitalised-looking complexion
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: dull, tired-looking skin that wants deep hydration and a plumper, dewy, more revitalised glow.

Size: 30ml
custom.key_benefits:
- Revitalises - for a fresher, more radiant-looking complexion
- Firms & smooths - supports firmer, smoother-looking skin
- Supports renewal - helps the skin look renewed and healthy
- Hydration - hyaluronic acid and beta-glucan for a plump, comfortable feel
What to expect: in clinical testing, PDRN's smoothing effect was visible from day 14 and measured at 28 days — use morning and evening for the best results.
custom.how_to_use:
Use morning and evening. After cleansing, press 3-4 drops onto slightly damp skin across the face and neck - pat gently, don't rub. Wait about a minute, then follow with your moisturiser (and SPF in the morning).
Complete the routine: seal it in with the PDRN + Collagen Night Cream in the evening.
custom.clinical_research:
PDRN is clinically shown to soften the look of crow's feet by up to 23% in 28 days.
In a randomised, double-blind split-face study, PDRN outperformed retinol head to head:
- Up to 23% less crow's-feet wrinkle area in 28 days, vs 6–7% with retinol
- Visibly smoother from day 14
- 1.8× the gain in firmness and elasticity seen with retinol
- No reactions in 31 women with sensitive skin
Ye et al. 2026, PLOS ONE: 31 women, 0.1% PDRN eye cream vs 0.1% retinol, twice daily for 28 days. Results describe the ingredient, not this product.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the PDRN 1% Renewal Serum do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A renewal serum with 1% PDRN (Sodium DNA), copper peptide, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It deeply hydrates and supports a smoother, refreshed and revitalised-looking complexion.

custom.faq_items.question: What is PDRN (Sodium DNA)?
custom.faq_items.answer: PDRN, shown on the INCI as Sodium DNA, is a salmon-derived ingredient popular in Korean skincare. In cosmetics it is valued for its hydrating, skin-conditioning properties that help skin look smoother and more refreshed. This serum contains 1% PDRN (Sodium DNA), or 10,000 ppm.

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: Use morning and/or evening on clean skin, 3-4 drops to face and neck, then follow with moisturiser (and SPF 30+ in the morning).

custom.faq_items.question: Can I pair it with the PDRN Collagen Night Cream?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Apply this serum first, let it absorb, then seal with the PDRN 1% Collagen Night Cream in the evening.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it vegan?
custom.faq_items.answer: No. PDRN (Sodium DNA) is salmon-derived, so it is not suitable for a vegan routine. It is free from parabens and mineral oil.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply PDRN Serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply 3-4 drops to face and neck for a revitalised, renewed-looking complexion.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Moisturise + SPF
custom.how_to_steps.description: Follow with your moisturiser. Finish with SPF 30+ every morning.
